title: Question 17
passage:
What should I put in the tray with the Returns label?
A. It needs to go on the bottom shelf. B. Anything a customer has sent back. C. We have three empty trays.
passageZh:
標著「退貨」的托盤要放什麼？
A. 要把它放在最下面那層架子。 B. 客人退回來的東西都放這裡。 C. 我們有三個空托盤。
